Q1: The renderer fix and its `--help` regression test are already on `main`. What should this issue deliver?
Choices:
A. Add only the cross-script guard under `tests/**`: one new parametrized test that imports each of the 35 `scripts/*.py` modules defining `build_parser()` and asserts `build_parser().format_help()` does not raise. Also add a `changelog.d/*.md` entry. No changes to `scripts/render_prompt.py` (RECOMMENDED)
B. No code change: close this issue as already fixed by a638db8, along with duplicates #9234, #9238 and #9244, and leave PR #9245 for maintainers to close. Getting the fix to consumers then depends only on the next `stable` release.
